data.title: Roadzen’s Accelerating Growth and AI Expansion Support a Buy Rating and $5 Price Target
data.description:
In a report released yesterday, Allen Klee from Maxim Group reiterated a Buy rating on Roadzen Inc, with a price target of $5.00.

Allen Klee’s rating is based on several factors, including Roadzen’s accelerating operating performance and expanding AI-driven insurtech platform. Second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue rose 29% year over year, exceeded estimates, and the company delivered its first quarter of positive adjusted EBITDA, indicating improving scale and execution. Management also maintained its goal of exceeding a $100 million annualized revenue run rate by the end of fiscal 2027.

Klee sees additional upside from the pending Riverside acquisition, which could contribute meaningful revenue and EBITDA, as well as from new partnerships and the expansion of Vehicle Care, Elite Insurance, and drivebuddyAI. He also viewed the roughly $10 million India subsidiary financing at an approximately $300 million valuation as supportive of growth and potentially helpful in reducing debt pressure. Finally, RDZN appeared undervalued relative to peers, supporting his $5 price target and Buy recommendation.
